name: Book and manage auto repair appointments with Retell AI and Google Calendar

parameters.content:
## Book auto repair appointments by phone with Retell AI and Google Calendar

### How it works

This workflow exposes a Retell AI function webhook for an auto repair shop and routes phone-call function requests to availability checking, booking, cancellation, or rescheduling paths. It validates the caller payload, reads or updates Google Calendar events, emails the shop owner about confirmed changes, and returns structured responses to Retell so the voice agent can continue the call.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Retell webhook URL to call this n8n webhook for the relevant Retell functions.
- Set the shop settings values for shopName, ownerEmail, calendarId, and timezone in the Set Shop Configuration node.
- Connect Google Calendar credentials with access to the configured repair shop calendar.
- Connect Gmail credentials for sending owner notifications.
- Ensure Retell function names and payload fields match the parsing logic in the availability, booking, cancellation, and rescheduling code nodes.

### Customization

Adjust the shop hours, appointment duration, event-title matching rules, notification email content, calendar ID, and timezone to fit the repair shop’s scheduling policies.

## Receive shop request

Accepts incoming Retell function webhook calls and attaches the shop-specific configuration used by the rest of the workflow.

## Authenticate and route

Checks that the request carries a Retell call ID, routes recognized function names to the correct branch, and returns immediate errors for unauthorized or unknown requests.

## Load availability events

Parses the requested date and time preference, then retrieves existing Google Calendar events for that day.

## Return free slots

Compares the calendar events against available shop appointment slots and returns the open times to Retell.

## Validate booking slot

Parses a booking request, checks the requested appointment window in Google Calendar, and decides whether the slot is still available.

## Confirm new booking

Creates the Google Calendar appointment, emails the shop owner, and confirms the booking back to Retell.

## Report slot taken

Returns a booking failure response when the requested appointment time is no longer available.

## Find cancellation appointment

Parses the cancellation request, loads the appointment day, searches for the caller’s event by name, and determines whether it was found.

## Confirm cancellation

Deletes the matched calendar event, emails the owner about the cancellation, and confirms the cancellation to Retell.

## Report cancel missing

Returns a response when no matching appointment is found for the cancellation request.

## Find original appointment

Parses a reschedule request, loads events on the original appointment day, finds the caller’s existing appointment, and branches based on whether it exists.

## Report original missing

Returns a reschedule failure response when the caller’s original appointment cannot be found.

## Validate new slot

Checks Google Calendar for the requested new appointment time and confirms whether the reschedule target slot is free.

## Complete reschedule

Creates the new appointment, deletes the original event, emails the shop owner, and returns a reschedule confirmation to Retell.

## Report new slot taken

Returns a reschedule failure response when the requested new time overlaps another calendar event.
